---
title: "Flexible Pavements"
---

This section focuses on pavement response, viscoelastic response, temperature, loading frequency, dimensional analysis, and related computational methods for flexible pavement systems.

## Articles & Technical Notes

### [IRI-02 — We Know How to Calculate IRI. But Can We Really Predict It?](../posts/iri-mechanistic-prediction/index.qmd)

Explores the distinction between calculating and predicting IRI through truck dynamics, ViscoWave pavement responses, empirical rutting relationships, and spatially varying pavement profiles.

More research articles on flexible-pavement response and viscoelastic modeling are planned.
